description: This script generates Redboot configuration files based on provided kernel and root filesystem images. It processes input parameters, calculates memory addresses and sizes, and outputs a script for the Redboot bootloader.

methods.name: parse_num
methods.description: Parses a numerical string, recognizing hexadecimal notation if present and returning the numeric value.

methods.name: gen_script
methods.description: Generates a Redboot boot script based on input parameters, file sizes, and computed addresses.
